title: Define Generate lifecycle

states.meaning: local/private GenerationIntent exists; no canonical AI or Compute state is implied
intent has an accepted application quote snapshot/reference; quote is not payment or compute settlement authority
a canonical 420AI job reference has been created/bound; underlying AI/Compute lifecycle remains authoritative
420Hz observes canonical AI execution as RUNNING; application state cannot force or skip the owning protocol transition
a canonical AI result commitment/manifest has reached VERIFIED or SETTLED and an output is available for review
the submitted generation ended in objective canonical failure/expiry or an unrecoverable bounded application failure; retry creates a new intent/run rather than rewriting history
the creator cancelled before submission or canonical cancellation was confirmed after submission; cancellation cannot erase earned/verified external entitlements
creator explicitly selected/reviewed a successful output and accepted the review/provenance handoff; does not imply Creative registration
canonical Creative Work/Recording references exist from successful registration; does not imply Recording activation or publication
canonical Creative publication prerequisites are satisfied and the Recording/release is published; later withdrawal/restriction is canonical Creative state, not lifecycle-history rewrite

allowedTransitions.guard: valid intent commitment and current quote/reference for the same intent; no canonical AI job required
creator explicitly abandons the local intent before submission
quote is rejected/expired/materially changed; return to editable draft without creating canonical AI state
creator explicitly submits; exact canonical 420AI job ID is created/bound to this intent; stale quote cannot be used
observed canonical AI job state is RUNNING; CREATED/FUNDED/MATCHED/ACCEPTED remain represented as SUBMITTED
canonical AI job enters FAILED or EXPIRED, or bounded submission orchestration irrecoverably fails with no runnable job
canonical AI cancellation is confirmed for an already-submitted job; local UI intent alone is insufficient
canonical AI job is VERIFIED or SETTLED with nonzero result and result-manifest commitments; RESULT_COMMITTED alone is insufficient
canonical AI job reaches FAILED or EXPIRED or verification fails under the owning policy
owning AI/Compute policy confirms legal cancellation; cancellation cannot erase verified receipts or earned external entitlement
creator explicitly selects an output and confirms review/provenance/disclosure handoff; automatic promotion is forbidden
canonical Creative registration returns valid native WorkId and RecordingId references; Work must satisfy Creative prerequisites; existence of PublishIntent alone is insufficient
canonical Recording is ACTIVE and the required release/catalog/media publication succeeds; product state cannot activate Creative state itself

aiStatusMapping.NONE: invalid/unbound; cannot support SUBMITTED or later

aiMappingRules: 420Hz may only advance from SUBMITTED to RUNNING on observed canonical AI RUNNING
RESULT_COMMITTED is not success; verification must complete before SUCCEEDED
VERIFIED is sufficient for SUCCEEDED even if economic settlement is still pending
SETTLED remains SUCCEEDED and does not create Creative registration
DISPUTED never advances product success; preserve the pre-dispute phase and block new forward transitions until resolution
REFUNDED does not independently define product cause; preserve FAILED or CANCELLED according to the preceding canonical reason

objectStateBindings.rule: one-way according to allowedTransitions; FAILED/CANCELLED/PUBLISHED are historical terminal states
must match observed AIJobRef state; cannot drive canonical AI mutation
cannot mark lifecycle REVIEWED without explicit creator review
cannot fabricate REGISTERED/PUBLISHED without canonical Creative references/status

retryPolicy.failed: retry MUST create a new GenerationIntent or a new immutable run binding with explicit supersession/reference; never rewrite FAILED history into RUNNING
retryPolicy.cancelled: resubmission MUST create a new intent/run; CANCELLED history remains terminal
retryPolicy.quoteRefresh: QUOTED may return to DRAFT and be re-quoted before canonical submission
retryPolicy.duplicateSubmission: same client request/idempotency key must resolve to the same canonical AI job or fail closed; never create parallel payable jobs silently

partialOutputPolicy.rule: partial artifacts may be retained as GenerationOutput/GenerationArtifact only when the owning AI/Compute result policy explicitly marks them admissible
partialOutputPolicy.lifecycle: partial output does not automatically mean SUCCEEDED; SUCCEEDED still requires canonical VERIFIED or SETTLED result under the accepted policy
partialOutputPolicy.publication: partial output cannot bypass REVIEWED, rights/provenance, REGISTERED or PUBLISHED gates

cancellationPolicy.preSubmission: DRAFT/QUOTED may be locally cancelled by the creator
cancellationPolicy.postSubmission: SUBMITTED/RUNNING require owning AI/Compute cancellation confirmation
cancellationPolicy.economics: 420Hz cancellation never directly refunds/transfers funds and cannot erase already-valid external earned entitlements
cancellationPolicy.replay: cancellation is idempotent and terminal for that intent/run

registered: returned IDs preserve native Creative identity
published: publication does not rewrite canonical rights/provenance history

invariants: HZGCA-LIFE-001 lifecycle state is 420Hz product state and never overrides canonical 420AI, ComputeMarket or Creative state
HZGCA-LIFE-003 FAILED and CANCELLED are terminal for that intent/run; retry uses a new intent/run or explicit supersession
HZGCA-LIFE-004 quote state never proves funding, payment finality, compute reservation or provider entitlement
HZGCA-LIFE-005 SUBMITTED requires an exact canonical 420AI job reference
HZGCA-LIFE-006 canonical AI CREATED/FUNDED/MATCHED/ACCEPTED map to SUBMITTED and cannot be presented as RUNNING
HZGCA-LIFE-007 RESULT_COMMITTED is not success; SUCCEEDED requires canonical VERIFIED or SETTLED result commitments
HZGCA-LIFE-008 DISPUTED blocks forward success progression until canonical resolution and cannot be converted to success by UI state
HZGCA-LIFE-009 cancellation after submission requires canonical owning-protocol confirmation and cannot erase external earned entitlements
HZGCA-LIFE-010 SUCCEEDED never implies rights ownership, Creative registration or publication
HZGCA-LIFE-011 REVIEWED requires explicit creator action and cannot be automatic
HZGCA-LIFE-012 REGISTERED requires native canonical WorkId and RecordingId references returned by Creative registration
HZGCA-LIFE-013 PUBLISHED requires canonical Recording ACTIVE plus successful release/catalog/media publication
HZGCA-LIFE-014 later Creative withdrawal/restriction does not rewrite historical PUBLISHED lifecycle; current availability is derived from Creative state
HZGCA-LIFE-015 private draft/output lifecycle events are not public Indexer/Search inputs until publication policy explicitly permits them
HZGCA-LIFE-016 duplicate/replayed submissions cannot create additional canonical payable jobs
HZGCA-LIFE-017 partial outputs cannot bypass verification, review, provenance, rights, registration or publication gates
HZGCA-LIFE-018 no lifecycle transition itself signs a wallet action, transfers funds, grants rights, resolves disputes or mutates another protocol
exitCriteria: canonical product lifecycle states and normal/exception paths are explicit
every legal transition has a guard and forbidden shortcut transitions are enumerated
420AI status mapping is explicit and does not duplicate AI authority
retry, cancellation, dispute and partial-output semantics are explicit
review, registration and publication gates are separated
machine verifier enforces lifecycle vocabulary, transitions and invariants
no contract ABI, deployment, provider or testnet claim is invented
HZ-GCA-1 remains open for HZ-GCA-1.4 through HZ-GCA-1.20
